units.areas: m²; divide by 10000 to display hectares

presentation.research_state_semantics: The milestones array retains original analytical M0–M6. Runtime M1 means Foundations, not research M1 turf stripping. M2/M3 are optional research details, not timeline buttons.

chapters.title: Today
chapters.endpoint: Original managed sports turf and existing use.

chapters.title: Foundations
chapters.endpoint: Brief preparation followed by visible foundation slabs; no frame or roof.
chapters.numerical_boundary: Retain one 3.2 ha disturbance and 0.8 ha original turf. The 1.2 ha foundation outline is authored visual geometry, not research M1 land allocation or a new runoff/soil result. Do not apply research M1 sealed-area metrics to this checkpoint.

chapters.title: Structure
chapters.endpoint: Frame and roof complete; other works remain bare, with original turf retained.

chapters.title: Ready
chapters.endpoint: Final campus allocation; reveal building versus whole campus and original recreational use. Start authored access reopening and repair; commissioning is separate from operation.

chapters.title: Operating
chapters.endpoint: Same completed land allocation with recurring water/power demand and independent proposals. Optional access recovery does not undo permanent occupation.

presentation.accounting: Seven research snapshots remain unchanged. Reworking the same ground never adds disturbance again. Foundation slabs and later roofs occupy the same footprint and must not be counted twice.
presentation.access_binding: Foundations introduces barriers before heavy access; preparation beats remain within that chapter. Structure retains temporary restrictions; Ready starts authored reopening/repair; Operating may show labelled time-compressed recovery. These are qualitative design directions, not verified engine behaviour or real access permissions.

metric_definitions.cumulative_disturbed_area_m2: Unique ground area worked inside the campus since M0; includes subsequently built or restored ground. Excludes unquantified external access wear. Never sum across milestones.
metric_definitions.sealed_area_m2: Roof footprint plus other impervious surfaces; not a measured infiltration rate.
metric_definitions.vegetated_ground_area_m2: Retained original turf plus restored vegetated ground; not habitat quality, maturity or public access.
metric_definitions.vegetated_ground_reduction_from_m0_m2: Starting vegetated ground minus current vegetated ground; not a count of lost playing fields.

scene_rules.intervention: Schematic 4 ha turf subset; no surveyed placement or fit. Trees and existing perimeter tracks stay outside quantified campus works. A separate illustrative access overlay can temporarily restrict a park path without converting it into campus hardstanding.
controls: Replay the same rain using existing water comparison
scene_rules.state: Use presentation.chapters for the five runtime targets. The milestones array is the original analytical reference; its M1 stripping state is not the new Foundations endpoint. Restore complete runtime states on jumps and replay; never add area counters.
scene_rules.geometry: Surface classes are disjoint and cover exactly 40000 m². Internal road/yard/utility subdivision is unassigned.
scene_rules.restoration: Restored vegetation is authored cover, not proof of mature soil, habitat or playable turf at opening.
scene_rules.cross_topic: Keep original water and energy results unchanged. No new runoff, energy, drought, temperature, carbon or biodiversity coefficients.
scene_rules.alternatives: Baseline layer only. Recycled-water and green-roof concept previews hide all numerical panels as required by the change brief.

temporary_construction_access.spatial_scope: Schematic park access corridor and external grass verge; no surveyed geometry, road name or area.

milestone_states.M0: Open park paths; no construction barriers or wear patch.
milestone_states.M1: Install temporary barriers and signed illustrative diversion before heavy access starts; reveal possible verge wear.
milestone_states.M2: Keep closure active; illustrate repeated access movement and worn grass.
milestone_states.M3: Keep closure active and grass-wear overlay; do not accumulate vehicle counts or damage area.
milestone_states.M4: Continue temporary construction access restriction and wear patch.
milestone_states.M5: Authored end of heavy-access phase: remove temporary works, reopen the schematic path and begin verge repair. Safe real reopening needs a handover plan.
milestone_states.M6: Show labelled time-compressed surface revegetation; no selected recovery duration or full soil-recovery claim.

temporary_construction_access.community_prompt: How will I get through the park during construction, and what will be repaired afterwards?
temporary_construction_access.visual_contrast: Temporary barriers and grass wear recede while the permanent campus footprint remains.
temporary_construction_access.accounting: Outside the 4 ha budget; not the existing 0.4 ha restored campus vegetation or 0.8 ha retained turf. No new water/energy credits or penalties.
temporary_construction_access.reset: Restore this overlay independently for each selected milestone. No temporary damage at M0; no cumulative growth on replay.

visual_reveals.trigger: M5 default once; skip/replay available; replay accessible at M6
visual_reveals.sequence: Translucent 1.2 ha building outline on original turf, completed building, slight camera pullback, supporting surfaces, full 4 ha boundary.
visual_reveals.caption: The building is only part of the space the project needs.
visual_reveals.interaction: Building / Whole campus emphasis toggle; no layout edit.

visual_reveals.trigger: Brief default beat after campus reveal; community detail optional
visual_reveals.sequence: Ghost original turf and schematic sports markings through the completed campus at the same position and camera.
visual_reveals.caption: Could people still use this space as before?
visual_reveals.limits: No surveyed pitch count or quantified permanent public-access loss. Temporary construction barriers are a separate authored access overlay.

visual_reveals.trigger: Offer after spatial reveal; optional investigation; no automatic milestone jump
visual_reveals.sequence: Reuse existing water replay comparing M0 and M5 with the same footprint, camera and recorded 86.4 mm reference-station rainfall depth.
visual_reveals.limits: Use existing modelled water results; particles illustrative, no flood depth or peak flow. Keep event replay separate from annual use.

demo_priority: Prioritise whole-campus reveal and same-rain investigation if time is short. No new milestones or accumulating resource counters.

milestones.title: Today
milestones.default_animation: Show the authored grass subset within the sports-field setting. Keep surrounding trees and tracks outside the intervention.
milestones.default_implication: The starting place already supports recreation; it is not unused land.
milestones.default_evidence_label: Authored demo areas; not a measured development plan
milestones.optional_question: What uses this space today, and which users should be involved?

milestones.title: Turf stripping
milestones.default_animation: Remove turf from the selected works area while keeping retained turf visible. Do not fell trees.
milestones.default_implication: Removing surface vegetation begins the physical change before buildings appear. Disturbed area is not yet sealed area.
milestones.default_evidence_label: Authored demo areas; not a measured development plan
milestones.optional_question: Which parts are removed, and which remain untouched?

milestones.title: Grading
milestones.default_animation: Reshape the same already stripped ground. Keep the intervention boundary fixed.
milestones.default_implication: The same area is worked again. Do not count it as a second land take or animate a new clearing.
milestones.default_evidence_label: Authored demo areas; not a measured development plan
milestones.optional_question: Does grading use more land, or change land already disturbed?

milestones.title: Compaction
milestones.default_animation: Roll the same prepared ground. Use a soil cutaway as a qualitative mechanism only.
milestones.default_implication: Ground preparation changes the soil condition without increasing the disturbed footprint. No compaction percentage or additional runoff is calculated here.
milestones.default_evidence_label: Authored demo areas; not a measured development plan
milestones.optional_question: Why can soil condition change even when the area counter stays the same?

milestones.title: Construction
milestones.default_animation: Raise roof/building blocks on part of the prepared ground; keep the remaining construction ground bare.
milestones.default_implication: The building footprint is only part of the development. This snapshot does not establish floor area, height or computing capacity.
milestones.default_evidence_label: Authored demo areas; not a measured development plan
milestones.optional_question: What other space will the completed campus need besides buildings?

milestones.title: Opening
milestones.default_animation: Complete internal hard surfaces and the restored vegetated patch. Label restored planting separately from retained turf.
milestones.default_implication: Roads, yards and supporting infrastructure also occupy land. New planting is not the same as keeping the original sports surface.
milestones.default_evidence_label: Authored demo areas; not a measured development plan
milestones.optional_question: Does a green patch inside a campus preserve the original recreational use?

milestones.title: Operation
milestones.default_animation: Keep the completed land allocation fixed while water and electricity animations operate. Offer a before/after surface overlay.
milestones.default_implication: Water and electricity recur, while the completed campus continues occupying the same land. A green-looking area does not establish public access or a playable field.
milestones.default_evidence_label: Authored demo areas; not a measured development plan
milestones.optional_question: Which original uses are displaced, and what access or replacement provision needs assessment?
